checks.name: Solver finished without errors
checks.meaning: A crash or floating-point exception usually means the solution blew up or a setting is invalid.

checks.name: No NaN values
checks.meaning: NaN (not a number) means the calculation produced invalid values.

checks.name: Max Courant number
checks.meaning: Fluid should not cross more than about one cell per time step (limit used: 1.0).

checks.name: Courant number trend
checks.meaning: A steadily growing Courant number is the typical signature of a blow-up.

checks.name: Residual trend: H
checks.meaning: Residuals should fall or level off. Growth suggests divergence (or a near-zero field whose normalised residual is only noise).

checks.name: Residual trend: p
checks.meaning: Residuals should fall or level off. Growth suggests divergence (or a near-zero field whose normalised residual is only noise).

checks.name: Continuity-error trend
checks.meaning: Mass-conservation error per step; strong growth means the solution is degrading.

checks.name: Temperature and pressure never fall below the start values
checks.meaning: Nothing in a closed tube of burning gas cools the gas below its start state. A value below it is an undershoot of the scheme at the front.

checks.name: The mass in the tube does not change
checks.meaning: The tube is closed.

checks.name: The grid passes checkMesh
checks.meaning: Equal cells in one row.

checks.name: One row per time step in the three per-step files, and the sampled states along the tube at the planned times
checks.value: 90 rows (36 steps of the planned size plus the growing first steps); 4 sampled states, 4 planned
checks.meaning: Fronts, totals and peaks are read from these files. No step may be longer than the planned one.

checks.name: The solver starts from the start state of Theory
checks.value: after the first step: mass differs by \(4762.74 \times 10^{-12}\) (relative), total energy by \(0.000\,\%\) of what the ignition layer holds above the gas around it, highest pressure \(3.0000\,\mathrm{MPa}\)
checks.meaning: Checks the mole ratio, the molar masses, the gas constant, the layer and the bookkeeping of the energy, all against values computed without the solver.

checks.name: The chemistry is running
checks.value: largest heat release rate in the short run \(40.84 \times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{W/m^3}\)
checks.meaning: A heat release that stays at zero would mean the reactions are switched off or the output is not written.

checks.name: Atoms kept during the short run
checks.meaning: The reactions only rearrange atoms.
